manifest.weights: same conditional mark u, reproduce frozen float32 reference normalization then true float64 F
manifest.moments: m0/s0 computed from the normalized F weights in float64; cached float32 moment discrepancy recorded
manifest.probability: same phase p_rule; p_eff computed from F with exact mark zero collisions
manifest.selection: one pair per market, shared across h1/5/10/20, minimizing mean_h log(raw_MQS_inner_Dva_h/identity_anchor_h)
manifest.tie: exact equal criterion: smaller squared distance to (1,1), then grid order
manifest.final: apply only selected pair plus fixed identity anchor to final reference; never score test grid
